scope: Read only sealed R18 generation preparations, source request contexts and original repository projection. No generation outputs, review decisions, native or audit labels. Census scripts are not a new experiment implementation.
method: Collect direct call identifiers and member attribute/selector names syntactically inside each included COMPLETE original anchor. Match every original non-test declaration supported by unchanged R18 catalog parser. Do not infer receiver/callee binding. Preserve all homonyms as an all-or-none name group under24KB. Compare call-only, call-priority+issue, and append-to-current budgets; these are source-only budget simulations.
limitations: Name references may be values, assertions, mocks, standard-library or unreachable nested functions; no reachability, public visibility or binding claim.
The R18 declaration parser does not retrieve Go global variable/constant docs or enclosing owner/package docs solely from a member name.
Group-ledger metadata can exceed prompt budget; metadata is local census evidence, not a proposed payload. Any actual variant must budget its entire serialized payload.
Call-only retrieval cannot retrieve oracle APIs never mentioned in the original anchors.
No context entry or source quotation is truncated in the stored declaration inventory. Headers in the short new_examples summary are display-only.

full_payload_budget_simulation.scope: Source-only sizing. Reuse the complete existing anchors. Retain all headers of a queried name together or omit that whole name group. Cap catalog entries at24KB AND complete prompt at96KB. All omission metadata stays local apart from counts.
full_payload_budget_simulation.P5_caution: A call-priority plus issue catalog that checks only24KB would overflow the96KB complete prompt. Joint budgeting omits additional whole API groups while keeping the complete existing anchor.
full_payload_budget_simulation.N08_caution: Naive call-order priority still spends about19KB on21 Set homonyms, then omits the proof dependencies. Budget existence is not retrieval effectiveness.

manual_N08_proof_pack.warning: Hindsight diagnostic pack only. Its APIs were chosen to explain a previously established source proof. Do not use this selection as a generic algorithm or experimental input.

collector_defects_and_counterexamples: Issue token retrieval treats ordinary words such as and/or/write/flush as possible API names. Earlier word positions can consume the entire catalog.
A source member name can denote a data field: info.KeyCount retrieves an unrelated sstable.KeyCount method. Member-name retrieval is not binding.
N08 Close has140 matches and Set21; N07 Close57, String49; P5/P6 Get matches both runtime/variable APIs. Preserve ambiguity, not a single name-first choice.
N10 item/key/check names span many builder classes; source receiver/import/type evidence is needed to prioritize candidates without claiming proof.
Python imported standard-library names can match unrelated project members, e.g P4 stdout/write.

Go type_spec documentation collection misses the preceding parent type_declaration comment block. WriteOptions field docs remain inside the type body, but Batch Atomic commit godoc is outside and would still be lost by the unchanged collector.
Go var Sync/NoSync docs are not eligible for the current function/type catalog, even when those options are used.
A function never called by the original anchors can still be necessary for a new oracle. Call-name retrieval alone does not expose such observation APIs.
Only available repository declarations are considered. Missing external dependency headers are unknown, not proof of no contract.
diagnosis.next_direction: Before attributing failure to the model, audit exact contract availability. A small generic retrieval change could prioritize source-proven package/import/receiver neighborhoods and public issue API syntax, include owner/type/option docs, and keep unresolved homonyms explicitly. Test evidence coverage and complete-prompt feasibility across all17 before any dispatch. Do not hardcode the known N08 proof pack.

owner_scoped_census.status: First uniform source-only budget simulation completed. No new generation variant has been implemented.
rules: Issue roots are identifiers inside code spans, qualified names, snake_case, lower-to-upper camel transitions, or all-capital names. Ordinary prose words and single-capital words alone are not roots.

Go preference: declaration in the same package directory as a prepared original anchor. Python/TypeScript preference: explicit original import resolves to a supplied source file. Preference is retrieval provenance, not data-flow binding.
Preserve all preferred homonymous declarations; when an explicit issue root has no preferred match, retain all global matches as an ambiguous group. Incidental anchor names have no global fallback.

Each method group includes its same-namespace receiver/owner type header and COMPLETE owner documentation. Go type_spec uses parent type_declaration documentation. Global Go var/const docs are eligible.
Keep whole root+owner groups in fixed issue order, then source-identifier order, subject to24KB catalog AND96KB complete prompt. No original anchor is dropped.
No task ID/API whitelist changes selection. The N08 presence checks are diagnostic evaluation after uniform selection, not selector inputs.
limits: Prototype census does not follow arbitrary reexports, generic factory data flow, imported Go modules, aliases, monkeypatches or runtime receiver dispatch.
Namespace ownership does not prove the receiver type of an original call. Explicit import file preference does not resolve every exported binding.
Large complete types or owners can be omitted; a simple group budget can still starve later contract dependencies.
Global var initializer text is a declaration reference; it is not an oracle proving expected runtime outputs.
This is an exploratory source-only analysis prompted by earlier source-evidence gaps, not a preregistered performance claim.

final_census_decision.last_uniform_rule: Public declaration headers and coherent exact documentation blocks. Member owners must be names already present in precise issue/API syntax or complete original anchors. No reverse expansion from a bare field name to every containing type. Whole groups only;24KB catalog and96KB complete prompt.
final_census_decision.cross_project_counterexample: N10 falls from23 records in the initial owner catalog to1 record under explicit-owner-name restriction. Its fluent API names do not expose their declaration owner in the issue/anchor syntax. This is retrieval undercoverage, not absence of useful contracts.
final_census_decision.implementation: No R27 core, driver, provider request or native experiment was created. Existing sealed R18/R22 files were not changed.
final_census_decision.interpretation: The missing documentation is an information-supply failure. This census does not prove that a model supplied the right contracts would succeed, nor that a small context selector would improve detection. A manually chosen N08 pack fits, but that hindsight pack is not an algorithm.

next_retrieval_hypothesis.idea: Let a bounded source-only model select declaration IDs from a compact immutable public signature/owner catalog, then programmatically fetch the complete corresponding documentation and at most one layer of exact declared-type dependencies.
next_retrieval_hypothesis.purpose: Select an observation-oracle dependency set without hand-coded API priorities or field-name reverse expansion. Preserve unresolved owners and homonyms rather than claiming call binding.
constraints: Only original source, public issue and complete original anchors supply catalog/selection inputs. No results, candidate correctness labels, old model answers or known proof pack.
Every declaration ID maps to exact path/span/SHA. The model may select IDs only; it cannot fabricate contracts, edit code or request unbounded retrieval.
Preserve all complete existing anchors and whole documentation blocks. Enforce catalog and final-payload budgets. Missing dependencies remain explicit unknown/omitted.
Use one common call/output/context budget and ordering for all17. Account for selection cost and compare against direct generation with the same total budget.
This adds a retrieval-planning stage, so it is not a pure catalog-order or metadata-compression ablation.
minimum_validation: Synthetic source tests for aliases, misleading field homonyms, explicit owners, Go parent type docs, global vars and unresolved fluent owners.
All17 source-only coverage and complete-payload census before any provider/native experiment.
If executed later, fresh full-test review, exact transport and controlled native execution remain necessary.
